title: NIST MEP National Network impact: Fiscal Year 2022
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
summary: MEP reported $18.8 billion in sales, $2.5 billion in savings, $6.4 billion in investment, and 116,700 jobs created or retained. The report says the network interacted with more than 33,500 U.S. manufacturers.
key_findings: MEP reported $18.8 billion in sales, $2.5 billion in savings, $6.4 billion in investment, and 116,700 jobs created or retained.
Method: Third-party survey of MEP clients reporting attributed sales, savings, investment, and jobs.
Denominator: Responding MEP client establishments in the stated fiscal year.
Attribution: Client-reported outcomes attributed to MEP assistance.
why_it_matters: This observation adds one of three time points for the nist mep national network impact series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for manufacturing cohort and facility production.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: The report says the network interacted with more than 33,500 U.S. manufacturers.
The observation is bounded to United States and the stated period.
The denominator is Responding MEP client establishments in the stated fiscal year.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
